1.web: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
1.asv: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

2.web: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
2.asv: Let them be put to shame and confounded That seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.

3.web: Let them be turned because of their shame Who say, “Aha! Aha!”
3.asv: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say, Aha, aha.

4.web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
4.asv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

5.web: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
5.asv: But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, make no tarrying.
